docs.title: Paginate Bounded Dictionary Pages
docs.description: Traverse native Dictionary page bodies with ordered Dictionary items and a body next marker. Next accepts same-origin absolute URLs or simple sibling filenames. Exact resolved-URL hash cycles, absent/empty next and literal caps stop traversal; either zero cap emits no GET. No headers, Link parsing, HTTP status verification, retry, transport timeout or trailing block contract. Native runtime acceptance remains required.
